Hello Monica / Avery,

Thanks for using ClearCheck. We need Avery to complete the online consent form to begin the standard employment verification and criminal background check. Estimated turnaround for standard checks is 48–72 hours after consent and document upload.

Action items for Avery (one-click links below):
1) Complete the consent form: https://app.clearcheck.com/consent/abcd1234
2) Upload a government ID (driver’s license/passport) and most recent paystub if available.
3) Authorize listed prior employers for verification (we will email any third-party contacts).

We have attached a PDF consent packet for records. If you prefer an alternate verification path (direct employer contact instead of portal upload), reply and we can coordinate.

Attachments: background-consent-AveryPark.pdf

Regards,
The ClearCheck team
